rule_outs: Dwelling 6 m from the best section
summary: Residential kerb where cars park; houses 13-17 m away on this side.

drivers.seclusion: Detached houses front onto this kerb at 13 m, 17 m and 11 m; apartments and shops across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with parked cars along the kerb; room for a van beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Moderate through traffic on Whitmore Street, near a junction.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs; 4P parallel signs apply 9 am to 7 pm Monday to Friday and Saturday morning only.

flags: Dwellings 10-25 m away on the section's own side
Steep at the north end: max 18% grade, mean 3.8% overall
No Parking Any Time sign near the south end
sun_shade: Street trees shade the west kerb from the afternoon sun; morning sun is blocked by houses less so.

best_section.where: West kerb opposite the shops, between the two side-street ends
